title: Vegas Crime Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See and hear about the sins of sin city. The Vegas Crime Tour is by the creators of the award-winning Vegas Mob Tour

The experience begins with a video about Vegas crime history which shocked the local community. The guide will relate stories of not only the crimes but also how clever, deviate, smooth and sometimes inept the criminals were. Law enforcement chased, followed, and caught a major portion of them.

Celebrity Crime stories including Michael Jackson, Benny Binion, Dean Martin, Tupac, B.B. King

The authenticity is the result of extensive research and firsthand information from law enforcement documentation, newspapers, media outlets, documentaries, books, and interviews.

Highlights include homicide locations, hotel bombing and arson, OJ Simpson’s 2007 arrest, John Wayne Gacy’s morbid/shocking history in Vegas.

During your next visit to Las Vegas experience this new, historical, educational, informative and entertaining tour that awaits you and your friends.
